text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrives for Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's this? Could this be my first
big step
towards becoming a
global-scale mascot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they wrote. Perhaps this is
about
how lovely I am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan begins to read the letter,
but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: Was it bad news or something?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It says, "I think all the time about how
much effort
you put in, Machan."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"When I mess up and feel down, I just
picture you
running."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And when I do, I feel like I can work
just as hard,
and move forward myself."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The thought of you running is my good
luck
charm."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A Machan charm to keep close at all
times...
That's not a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Still, this is all a bit funny.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All I wanted was to be remembered...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This fan said that they remembered her,
and that
just picturing her was enough to
touch their heart,
and keep on
motivating them.
choice_data_list: Isn't that what makes it memorable?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The me in their memories touched their
heart...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I think this might be it. This could be
the true
purpose of an international
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, Trainer, I have to give
training
all my effort today, too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure this fan remembers a
me
who's giving even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Aston Machan puts in
a
noticeably higher amount of effort
during our
training sessions.
